verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-configurable automation or background-job feature that an AI-native user could set up to run autonomously. What it does show is adjacent: payout-frequency settings, custom fraud rules applied to each payment, webhooks that replace polling, and an MCP server for interactive natural-language API calls. These are domain-specific settings or developer building blocks, not general automations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
